newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian GDP falls 6.0 pct in first 10 months.
newsitem.headline: Russian GDP falls 6.0 pct in first 10 months.

text.p: Russian gross domestic product in the first 10 months of this year totalled 1,819 trillion roubles, which was six percent less than a year earlier in inflation-adjusted terms, the State Statistics Committee said on Wednesday.
GDP in October was one percent lower than in September and six percent lower than a year earlier.
Note - Official Russian data tend to underreport a growing private sector in the economy.
